name: Get the list of Documents of a Request / Incident
description: Returns the list of documents attached to the specified incident or request

documents.description: From `Documents` (capital `D` in the API). Items are returned **as is**, with keys `HREF`, `PARENT_HREF`, `DOCUMENT_ID`, `DOCUMENT` (file name) and `DDL_HREF` (download link). They are not renamed. `DOCUMENT_ID` (format `<n>_<sha256>`, e.g. `40000_9ae8…`) is the identifier expected by *Get a specific Document* and *Delete a request document* (Q10 resolved). `HREF` is a web UI link (`autoconnect_mail.php?...`) that returns an HTML login page, not the file
